execution.raw_text:
{
  "up": "Select assay_chembl_id, target_type, tax_id, canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, pchembl_value
Join molecule_dictionary md on activities.molregno = md.molregno
Join assays a on activities.assay_id = a.assay_id
Join target_dictionary td on a.tid = td.tid
Left Join compound_structures cs on md.molregno = cs.molregno
Filter activities.standard_relation = '='
Filter activities.pchembl_value is not null
Filter td.tid = 2061
Filter td.tax_id = 9606
Filter td.target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN'
Filter activities.type = 'IC50'
Order by molecule_chembl_id, assay_chembl_id
Limit 1000"
}
